answer: Before dawn, the copper lines of the postal network already decide who is real: each agent identity must receive a unique one-time code by Royal Mail Special Delivery at a distinct residential address in the Postcode Address File. A farm ordering 500 letters pays about 7 pounds per tracked delivery plus renting 500 real addresses, and PAF deduplication flags any address reused twice. The spiral tightens when one letter goes missing — the batch freezes while the address is re-checked, so a forger reusing a single flat loses every identity tied to it at once.
